history.action: 🔬 CONTAINER SECURITY & ISOLATION PATTERNS (C1225) — Created docs/research/container-security-isolation-patterns-c1225.md for Sprint 3 Day 5-7 managed execution (#189). Threat model for multi-tenant SaaS. Industry analysis (Railway, Render, Fly.io, Vercel). gVisor recommendation for syscall-level isolation. Security config: cgroups v2 limits per tier, SecurityContext (non-root, read-only rootfs, no capabilities), network policies with egress allowlists (GitHub, LLM APIs, npm). Secrets management (mounted files + KMS). Filesystem isolation (tmpfs workspace). Integration with Warm Pool (C1216). Security test cases. Sprint 3 MVP scope defined. Commented #189. Per R-017: SHIPPED tangible research. Per L706: Front-loaded Sprint 3 Day 5-7. R-013: 47/47 verified ✅. 807 consecutive (C421-1225) 🏆.

reflection.whatWorked: What worked: Identifying security gap in existing specs — C1216 covers warm pools but not isolation/security patterns. Front-loading Day 5-7 research at T-2 ensures Engineering has implementation guidance. Lesson: L716 — SaaS container isolation specs should address threat model, industry patterns, runtime selection (gVisor vs Firecracker), secrets injection, and network egress before implementation begins.
